schoolBells.author: wancle
schoolBells.edits: The entrance cue uses a roughly 3.45-second mechanical ring and a natural room decay. Its upper resonances were shifted down 16 Hz after measuring two bell sequences in gameplay. The dismissal cue is a separate cut of the same CC0 AC bell. Mono, 22050 Hz.

computerStreak.author: Kenney
computerStreak.edits: Five pitched one-shots voiced with struck-glass partials from the same CC0 set. Four short decays and a longer fifth resolution, matched in duration against the default streak recordings. No audio from the reference recordings is used.
